problem: Consider $E=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]$ and a $3\times 3$ matrix $A.$ Find the row operation that, when applied to $A,$ is equivalent to multiplying $A$ by the given elementary matrix $E$ from the left.

activity_context.topic_title: Row Operations on 3x3 Matrices as Products of Elementary Matrices

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Row Operation Equivalent To Left Multiplication by an Elementary Matrix
examples.problem:
Consider ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14060012/assets/ba3f1852b12b6f4a246a855c88c9b867b7e750c6dddf350cab0324629fc047c4.png) and a $3\times 3$ matrix $A.$
Find the row operation that, when applied to $A,$ is equivalent to multiplying $A$ by the given elementary matrix $E$ from the left.
examples.worked_solution:
The given matrix $E$ is obtained by taking the second row of $I$ and adding $7$ times the third row:

$$
\begin{aligned}I & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+7{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =E\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $EA$ is equivalent to applying the elementary 
row operation $R_2 :=R_2+7R_3$ to $A.$
